summary: ACRES Commercial Realty Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Equity Distribution Agreement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $50 million. The company acts as issuer, selling through Raymond James as sales agent at a commission not exceeding 2.0%. This routine capital-raising program is not a special situation; it represents ordinary shelf takedown activity. The filing includes no deal terms tied to an acquisition, divestiture, tender, or similar event. Watch for future sales disclosures but no specialized angle applies.
